name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Form the Partial-Cube Part
scope: Finite binary classes on active coordinates.
statement: The connected members of the conditioning-minimal non-ample class are exactly its members with at least three concepts.
proof: Every member with at least three concepts is isometrically embedded and therefore connected. A two-concept member is an ambient antipodal pair on at least two coordinates, so its two vertices are isolated.
